project.name: EpiowAI Organization Tooling
project.summary: Organization-level GitHub profile, community files, agent adapters, and reusable workflow surfaces for EpiowAI repositories.
goals: Publish EpiowAI organization profile and community entry points.
Provide EpiowAI-owned issue templates, pull request template, and reusable GitHub Actions workflows.
Expose local agent adapter surfaces without forking enterprise doctrine.
nonGoals: Own EpiowAI product application code or customer-facing runtime behavior.
Own enterprise engineering doctrine, standards, or project manifest schema.

owns.name: organization-github-surfaces
owns.description: EpiowAI organization profile, community templates, reusable workflows, and local agent adapter files.

doesNotOwn: Product-specific application behavior owned by each EpiowAI product repository.
Enterprise doctrine and manifest schema owned by SylphxAI/doctrine.
Organization Renovate relay policy owned by EpiowAI/renovate-config.

allowedDependencies.surface: project manifest schema and engineering doctrine

forbiddenCouplings: Do not hardcode product-specific behavior into organization-wide templates or workflows.
Do not fork doctrine standards into this repository; link to SylphxAI/doctrine.
Do not make product repositories depend on private files outside the listed public surfaces.

delivery.deployPath: not-applicable: organization profile, templates, and reusable workflows are served directly from GitHub after merge to main.
delivery.productionProof: GitHub main readback plus doctrine project-control audit; reusable workflow behavior is proven by downstream consumer workflow runs.

gaps.description: CONTRIBUTING.md still describes a dev-branch, human approval, and build-check flow that does not match current no-human doctrine or main branch protection readback.
gaps.target: Open a follow-up docs/process PR after manifest rollout.

gaps.description: .github/workflows/README.md still uses SylphxAI wording/examples; decide whether EpiowAI owns standalone reusable workflows or delegates examples to SylphxAI/.github.
gaps.target: Open a follow-up workflow-doc freshness PR after manifest rollout.
